scalars.scalar_value: Any combination equivalent to: experience performing regularly scheduled operation of large power gang mowers and other grounds construction equipment.

items.item_text: 01. Do you have a valid California driver's license? (Required for this Position) Options: Yes | No
02. If you answered "yes" to the above, please attach verification to your application prior to submission of this application. Options: Yes | No
LICENSES AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS:
Valid California driver's license.
Any combination equivalent to: experience performing regularly scheduled operation of large power gang mowers and other grounds construction equipment.

Perform skilled operation of large gang mowers, power mowers, tractors, skip loaders, backhoes, augers, aerators, forklifts, trucks, chain saws, power edgers, power trimmers and other grounds maintenance and construction equipment.
Use tractor attachments as the job demands.
Service and make repairs to grounds equipment as needed.
Fill, drag, level, roll, smooth and prepare ground for planting of lawns; level ground and build mounds for athletic fields.
Haul dirt, trash, fertilizer and other materials; adjust lawn mowers; mow lawns and fields.
Mix and apply chemicals used for weed control.
Prune trees and shrubs.
Install landscaped areas, working from blueprints or rough sketches; line athletic fields.
Fertilize lawns, using and mixing chemicals; drag infields; perform groundskeeping custodial duties.
Load equipment on trailers, pull trailers to work sites and unload equipment at work sites.
Operate District vehicles.
OTHER DUTIES:
Perform related duties as assigned.
Operation, use and maintenance of large gang mowers and other powered grounds equipment, tractors and attachments.
Perform general groundskeeping work.
Incumbent will be involved in field work which requires travel in a vehicle to various sites.
Methods, materials and tools used in groundskeeping work.
Use herbicides and fertilizers in an appropriate and safe manner.
Incumbents may be required to wear protective apparel including goggles, face protectors, aprons, shoes and breathing apparatus.
Appropriate safety precautions and procedures.
Understand and follow oral and written instructions.
WORKING CONDITIONS:
Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others.
Perform skilled grounds equipment operation work, including the operation of tractors, trucks, large power gang mowers and attachments.
Operate a vehicle observing legal and defensive driving practices.
Be flexible to perform work within changing priorities and possess sufficient interpersonal skill to work harmoniously with staff, students, administrators, parents and others.
